title: GitLab critical patch release 19.5.1 (CVE-2026-110264)
unpatched_lines_note: Every GitLab CE/EE line from 7.0 up to 18.10 is affected and has no backport. Upgrade along the official upgrade path to a fixed line.

cves.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution through an integer overflow when compiling a crafted regular expression
Cache poisoning in OAuth/OIDC discovery endpoints

scope: Self-managed only (Omnibus, Docker, Helm chart, Operator, source). GitLab.com is patched. GitLab Dedicated tenants on 19.3.5-internal0 and 19.4.2-internal0 or later already include the fixes. GitLab Runner is a separate product and not covered by this advisory.
notes: Helm chart and Operator versions do not equal GitLab versions. Map them with the official chart version mappings before deciding status.
Follow the official upgrade path; jumping several minors can skip required background migrations.
GitLab published exploitation detections: Onigmo native worker crash, and Org mode render error burst.
